// # Self-intersecting patches

// Whitney's umbrella (u v, u, v^2), with (u, v) sweeping Domain. The normal form
// of a stable map singularity: a self-intersecting sheet ending in one pinch
// point at the origin (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Whitney_umbrella).
type WhitneyUmbrella
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Domain: Bounds2D;
